source: Edited real UI snapshots at 1280x648 and 1440x900, device scale 2. Actions were performed through the application in an isolated synthetic database. The successful real CPU Qwen conversation was restored from reports/model-problem.json and is explicitly identified as a saved answer. No live inference during capture is claimed. Corporate access, help requests and Jira are real HTTP calls to the PostgreSQL-backed simulation; no real colleagues were contacted. Go output is the unchanged output of the isolated practical test, not model shell execution.

narration.alignment: Provider character timings, paragraph boundaries; no local ASR

verification.manual_visual_review: All scene beats, seams, phone sheets, enlarged role and status panels, decoded output frames. Fresh-eye visual review found P1 issues; roles, source framing, key result and reload labels were improved.
verification.intentional_warning: timeline_track_too_dense: twelve labels share one caption host. Readable proof states deliberately use data-hold.

viewing: Desktop Full HD; opening overview and small UI metadata require pausing or zoom on a phone.
